rationale: CPU is faster at every paired position in all four cases; S4 GPU total mean is 1.6361 times CPU. Resource feasibility succeeds, but current synthetic performance makes a real attempt low-value.

prior_invalidated_attempt.reason: Snapshot serialization of absent optional result fields produced object arrays rejected by allow_pickle=False.
prior_invalidated_attempt.scope: S1 CPU complete; GPU stopped after first warmup; no valid paired result.
prior_invalidated_attempt.corrected: Optional scalar fields use safe JSON scalar encoding; round-trip unit test added.
prior_invalidated_attempt.disposition: Complete S1-S4 restarted; none of the incomplete attempt timings enter statistics.
prior_invalidated_attempt.cache_effect: The failed attempt can populate CuPy on-disk cache. Final run is a fresh worker, not a virgin cache measurement.

warmup_analysis: Four warmup calls per backend/case retained and excluded. S2 GPU A warmup 1 is 5.388857 s versus warmup 2 0.588763 s. First-use costs exist despite explicit RawKernel compilation. Cache/context effects are not individually decomposed. Post-warmup distributions include all variability; stationarity is not claimed.
transfer_analysis: T6-T5 is only 0.18-0.28 ms on average. GPU regression already exists inside the synchronized public T5 boundary. H2D/D2H, canonical materialization and required synchronization remain included; individual contributions are not isolated. Evidence does not establish whether transfer or compute dominates T5.

source_guard.qualification: Python/Arrow and admitted-child fail-closed guarded scope, not independent native-byte telemetry.

validation.benchmark_validation: The final complete matrix is the evidence run; no second validation benchmark.
validation.warning: CuPy reports CUDA_PATH could not be detected; all CUDA correctness and benchmark calls succeed.

environment_limitations: Existing interactive Windows environment; background load not controlled. Brief compileall overlaps the matrix. Large timing variability in S1/S3 retained; no outlier removal, significance or stationary-distribution claim.

full_real_readiness.adapter_supervision: Synthetic worker containment and snapshots now demonstrated. Full-real preparation adapter, identity gates and GPU failure supervision remain unvalidated; no full-real adapter implemented.

structural_comparison.interpretation: Observed S4 static/state pool used differs by only 2500 bytes from its graph+state formula. Reserved high-water includes allocator scratch/caching; context and other device users are outside pool. The 616-MiB U estimate is for larger counts, not the requested S4 graph.
